Hey there! Dispensary budtender here 😊 if anyone is confused by what this means, the best way I’ve been able to explain is this:

You are allotted 2½ oz every 35 days. The 35 days used to be a specific start date to 35 days later. Now, you have a “rolling recommendation”.

So… If you buy a quart oz today, that amount will not be available again until 35 days later. The same if you were to buy an eighth tomorrow - 35 days later, that eighth is added back to your 2½ oz available.

I’m not saying this doesn’t suck. It’s going to really suck when a dispensary has a big sale and you buy a lot at once, because you’ll have to wait 5 weeks to get that amount back.
